title: A Bill To that came from the old default follows the new default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, customer A's payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer E, customer D's payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the new customer, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer E.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, created after customer A's default was saved, so its Bill To came from the default.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  4. Pick customer D.
  5. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The customer picker opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 5:

  • The work order's customer is customer D.
  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer E's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
